title: Emmy Noether: Modern LaTeX Working Corpus and Multilingual Translation Drafts (Paper 06 Slavic Tranche 001)
description:
This is the reader-facing Emmy Noether working record for the Modern LaTeX Editions of Mathematics Manuscripts project. It continues to front 00_Noether_German_Cumulative_Working_SourceControl_v26_R822integrated_20260717.pdf, the 466-page German working reader, with its editable and source-audit evidence grouped in file 07.

New multilingual payload: file 08_Noether_Paper06_Slavic_WorkingTranslation_Tranche001_20260716.zip adds a self-contained Paper 06 working corpus with sixteen units each in Interslavic Latin, Interslavic Cyrillic, Russian, and Ukrainian. It includes 67 editable TeX files, 65 compiled PDFs, sixteen translation-unit records, the German and English generation controls, source-scan witness, methodology, render checks, audit ledgers, and a verified 180-row checksum manifest. Fable Tranche 001 applies seventeen reviewed orthographic replacements to the Interslavic branches; Russian and Ukrainian are unchanged controls in this tranche.

Open work: the Paper 06 translations still require a fresh line-by-line source-delta reconciliation against the current German authority. Successful compilation and visual QA do not certify linguistic, semantic, or mathematical correctness. This package is therefore a working multilingual tranche, not a final or source-closed Paper 06 translation.

Status caveat: the wider record is a serious source-repair and translation working corpus, not a critical edition, author-wide source-faithfulness certification, paper-by-paper certification, complete multilingual synchronization, native-language approval, or publication-grade proofreading. Inherited terms such as COMPLETE, closure, or closed refer only to bounded local tasks.

GitHub: corrections, source comparisons, LaTeX fixes, and translation improvements can be suggested via issues or pull requests at https://github.com/KokunoYumeto/modern-latex-manuscripts.
notes: Reader-first public surface with the v26/R822 German working source-control head and a new Paper 06 Slavic working-translation tranche. The added Interslavic, Russian, and Ukrainian units are not source-closed or native-certified. Not a critical edition or complete multilingual synchronization.
